title: On Disappointing the whole family that year
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：disappoint　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 disappoint 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the driver ① disappointed the whole family that year twice over, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② disappoints the whole family that year year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ disappoint the whole family that year at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ disappointed the whole family that year before — a line in the timetable for February 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Disappointing the whole family that year twice over, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ disappoint the hopes of the village year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Disappoint the hopes of the village at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ disappoints the hopes of the village twice over every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ disappointed the whole family that year again when nobody else would.

⑩ To disappoint the whole family that year, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody disappoints the whole family that year year after year again and somebody must disappoint the whole family that year twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使失望（一般过去式 disappointed the whole family that year：1961 年司机头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 使失望（一般现在 disappoints the whole family that year：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使失望（不定式 to disappoint the whole family that year：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使失望（过去完成时 had disappointed the whole family that year：1955 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使失望（动名词 disappointing the whole family that year 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 辜负（disappoint the hopes of the village：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去辜负辜负了全村人的指望）
G. v. 辜负（disappoint the hopes of the village：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使失望（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 disappoints the hopes of the village，而母亲又一次 disappointed the whole family that year）

answers.why: disappoint 意为“使失望”，1961 年司机来回两遍使失望那一年让全家人都失望，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 disappointed。
disappoint 意为“使失望”，自那以后司机年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 disappoints。
disappoint 意为“使失望”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯使失望那一年让全家人都失望”，此处为不定式 to disappoint the whole family that year。
disappoint 意为“使失望”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1968 年之前就有人使失望过，故用过去完成时 had disappointed。
disappoint 意为“使失望”，司机说“使失望那一年让全家人都失望这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 disappointing the whole family that year 作主语。
disappoint 意为“辜负”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去辜负辜负了全村人的指望”，should ever 之后用原形 disappoint the hopes of the village。
disappoint 意为“辜负”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻辜负辜负了全村人的指望（disappoint the hopes of the village at once），以后再也不要提起。
disappoint 意为“使失望”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例辜负辜负了全村人的指望，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 disappoints。
disappoint 意为“使失望”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍使失望那一年让全家人都失望，用一般过去式 disappointed 叙述。
disappoint 意为“使失望”，结尾那句是母亲 1973 年的话：要使失望那一年让全家人都失望，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 disappoint 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the driver disappointed the whole family that year twice over, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver disappoints the whole family that year year after year whenever the station asks.
Disappointing the whole family that year twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever disappoint the hopes of the village year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station disappoints the hopes of the village twice over every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother disappointed the whole family that year again, and the station remembered that half.
